why: The sections are a list joined by AND: any order survives and three of them move the train not at all (structure 1, 3; judging 13).

review.logline: A tour of comets (what they are, famous ones, the two tails, a mission to come) that never asks why a comet leaving the Sun flies tail first.
review.synopsis: Section 1 gives comet facts: ice and dust, an orbit round the Sun. Section 2 lists Halley, Hale-Bopp and NEOWISE. Section 3 names the dust and the gas tail. Section 4 looks ahead to Comet Interceptor. The plan's payoff line is about the wind, but no section carries the wind.

flags.problem: Famous comets moves the train not at all; it could sit anywhere.
flags.fix: Cut it, or turn one comet into the case that raises the question.

flags.problem: Future missions answers nothing the film asked.
flags.fix: Cut it; end on the opening comet.

flags.problem: Section 1 opens on what comets are made of; the comet flying tail first, which the title promises, is not shown or asked about.
flags.fix: Open on a comet leaving the Sun with its tail ahead, and ask why.

flags.problem: No section says what is at risk: the plan's stakes (the wind reaching Earth) appear nowhere, and the film explains before it gives a reason to care.
flags.fix: Put the wind that reaches Earth into section 1, before any mechanism.

flags.problem: Q1 is marked closed in Tail types, but naming two tails does not say why the tail leads.
flags.fix: Close Q1 with the answer: the tail is pushed outward, by sunlight and by the wind.

flags.problem: The last section is about a future mission; the promise is not paid there.
flags.fix: End on the opening comet seen again, with the payoff line.

first_minute.promise_match: From the plan (no script yet): section 1 shows a comet nucleus and says comets are ice and dust; the comet is named, but its tail leading it, which the title promises, is not.
first_minute.question_and_stakes: From the plan: no question beyond what a comet is, and nothing at stake for the viewer.

problems.problem: A list of comets, joined by AND.
problems.fix: Make each section the consequence of the one before (BUT or THEREFORE).
